mutants.replacement:
wildcardRegExpCache[path] &&= new RegExp(
    `^${path.replace(
      /\/:[^/{}]+(?:\{\[\^\/]\+})?(?=[/{]|$)|\/?\*$|([.\\+*[^\]$()?{}|])/g,
      (match, metaChar) =>
        metaChar
          ? `\\${metaChar}`
          : match === '/*'
            ? TAIL_WILDCARD_REG_EXP_STR
            : match === '*'
              ? ONLY_WILDCARD_REG_EXP_STR
              : `/:${LABEL_REG_EXP_STR}`
    )}$`
  )
